_readme: Every amount below was read on the official page in `url` on `read` (curl unless `via` says WebFetch). Nothing is estimated or taken from an aggregator. A field left out means the schedule does not print it, and the site then shows no figure for it. Vehicles: car = car, SUV or minivan; pickup = pickup or cargo van; trailer = pickup towing a trailer or a large trailer.

facilities.name: Salt Lake Valley Landfill
facilities.flatNote: flat rate for cars, SUVs, pickups up to a 1-ton pickup and trailers unloaded by hand; trailers towed by 1-ton or larger trucks are weighed

cd.label: clean concrete, asphalt, soil or sod

notes: Mixed trash may include green waste, concrete, asphalt, soil and sod at the flat rate.
Mattresses and box springs $18 each for residential customers.
Tires $4 each, 12 per load at most.

facilities.name: Seminole Road Landfill
notes: Loads under 2,000 lbs pay the minimum scale fee of their weight band; heavier loads pay $99.80 a ton.
The schedule also lists a $14.70 minimum processing fee; we do not add it to the weight bands because the schedule does not say how the two combine.
Tires under 18 inches $3.50 each, over 18 inches $16, with rims $30.
Transfer stations (Central, East, North): $105 a ton.

facilities.name: Miramar Landfill
facilities.operator: City of San Diego Environmental Services (public)
facilities.flatNote: Tier 1 (cars, SUVs, pickups, vans, trailers up to 5 x 9 x 4 ft) and Tier 2 (pickup with a trailer, larger trailers), city waste

nonRes.label: waste from outside the City of San Diego

notes: Flat rates already include the state recycling fee ($15 a ton) and the city business tax where it applies.
Appliances, TVs and electronic waste must be disposed of elsewhere before entering the landfill.
Uncovered loads: $50.
facilities.residentHelp: Yes for City of San Diego residents. Poway, El Cajon, Chula Vista and other cities: No, which pays more.

facilities.name: North and South transfer stations
facilities.freonNote: $9 per appliance plus the tonnage rate when other material is in the load; $34 per appliance for an appliance-only load (2 at most)
notes: The $37 minimum covers up to 420 lbs of garbage.
Vehicle tires only: $16 per load, 4 tires at most.
Unsecured loads: $3 minimum, $5 up to 1 ton, $10 above.

facilities.name: King County transfer stations
facilities.effectiveText: 2026 rates, effective January 1, 2026, approved by the King County Council on September 16, 2025

next.note: 2027 self-haul rates announced September 29, 2026, moderate risk waste surcharge and state refuse tax included

notes: Self-haul minimum $40.25 per vehicle, $243.38 a ton above it in 2026.
Yard and wood waste: $20.70 for sedans and two-door hatchbacks, $129.38 a ton for all other vehicles.

facilities.name: 27th Avenue and North Gateway transfer stations

residentFree.label: Phoenix residents who pay for full city trash service: one load up to a ton, once a month, free

notes: Residents' loads over one ton leave a cash deposit and pay $55 a ton for the excess.
Residents may bring up to five automobile tires a year (rims removed).
Two CRT units per household per month free, then $20 each plus disposal.
Unsecured load penalty: $20.
facilities.residentHelp: Yes if you pay the City of Phoenix for full trash service: one load a month, up to a ton, is free. No for everyone else.

facilities.name: Orange County Landfill, Porter and McLeod Road transfer stations

cd.label: Class III: construction and demolition debris, furniture, clean fill; landfill only

notes: Class I garbage $56.40 a ton at the landfill and both transfer stations.
Yard waste $48.70 a ton at the landfill; at a transfer station it pays the Class I rate.
Up to 8 passenger tires $3 each; larger tire loads $249 a ton.

facilities.name: Olinda Alpha and Prima Deshecha landfills
notes: Autos, minivans and SUVs: $15 for loads under 360 lbs. Pickups and vans: $30 for loads under 880 lbs.
Over 880 lbs: $92.70 a ton, or $107.70 with hard-to-handle items.
Hard-to-handle items longer than six feet (wood, furniture, mattresses): $15 more.

facilities.name: Kiefer Landfill
facilities.flatNote: cars, station wagons and small SUVs $10; small vans and large SUVs $20; pickups $35; large vans $45
notes: Vehicles with trailers, box trucks and loads with 9 or more tires are weighed.
Up to 2 large appliances a day and mattresses from non-business loads: no fee.
Passenger tires: 4 a day free, the 5th to 8th $10 each.

facilities.name: North Area Recovery Station
facilities.flatNote: cars, station wagons and small SUVs $10; small vans and large SUVs $20; pickups $40; large vans $50
notes: A pickup with trash and three refrigerators pays $40 + $40 = $80 (the county's own example).
Up to 2 large appliances a day and non-business mattresses: no fee.

facilities.name: South Wake Landfill
facilities.effectiveText: page for haulers, no date printed on it
notes: $37 a ton includes the $2 a ton North Carolina excise tax.
Mattress or box spring $15 each.
The page is written for haulers and prints no minimum charge.

facilities.name: I-66 Transfer Station and I-95 Landfill Complex
facilities.effectiveText: residential rates for July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027
facilities.minNote: the schedule prints three weighed minimums (small $39, medium $49, large $98); we match them to car, pickup and trailer

cd.label: brick, concrete, dirt, rock, shingles (up to 2 cubic yards a day)

notes: Proof of Fairfax County residency may be asked.
Trash 1 to 5 bags $21, 6 to 10 bags $28; seniors (60 and over) $10 for 1 or 2 bags.
Appliance needing Freon or capacitor removal $15 each; white goods otherwise $98 a ton.
Mattress and box spring: $17 each as a large single item.

facilities.name: Franklin County Sanitary Landfill
facilities.operator: Solid Waste Authority of Central Ohio (public)
facilities.effectiveText: no date printed; the authority's own FAQ dates the $39.75 rate to April 1, 2017

nonRes.label: waste from outside the district of the Solid Waste Authority of Central Ohio (SWACO)

cd.label: construction and demolition debris, landfill only since September 29, 2025

notes: Residents pay a $5 minimum; the fee is prorated below one ton.
Jackson Pike Transfer Station $51.75 a ton, Morse Road Transfer Station $52.75 a ton (in-district).
Loads must be fully tarped.

facilities.name: McCommas Bluff Landfill
facilities.perTonExtraLabel: customer processing fee $2 a ton and environmental fee $2 a ton
notes: Price per ton at the gate: $45.78 from October 1, 2026 (was $43.60).
Customers paying by cash, check or card for single loads also pay a $2 a ton processing fee and a $2 a ton environmental fee.
Uncovered load: $40. Northwest Transfer Station (Bachman): $71.28 a ton at the gate, on the city's landfill page.

facilities.name: County landfills and transfer stations
facilities.operator: San Bernardino County Solid Waste Management (public)
facilities.effectiveText: pricing effective July 1, 2023, still the schedule posted on November 7, 2026

smallLoad.label: up to 300 lbs of ordinary residential waste

notes: Up to 300 lbs of residential waste: $13.71. From 301 lbs: $61.49 a ton, prorated.
Tires off the rim, up to nine a load: $5.31 each.
Hard-to-handle and special handling: $53.14 a ton more, $26.57 minimum under 2,000 lbs.
Uncovered loads pay double.

facilities.name: Badlands, Blythe, Lamb Canyon and El Sobrante landfills
facilities.operator: Riverside County Department of Waste Resources (public)
facilities.flatNote: flat-rate vehicles: car, van or SUV; pickup or trailer up to an 8 ft bed; pickup and trailer up to 4 ft high
notes: Routine refuse $52.68 a ton for direct-haul customers; minimum load fee $43.20 for vehicles not on the flat-rate list.
Hard-to-handle flat rates: $21.10 car or pickup, $57.10 pickup with trailer.
Residential passenger tires: $6 each, five a day at most.
Uncovered load surcharge: $25.

facilities.name: North Dade and South Dade landfills, Resources Recovery Facility
facilities.operator: Miami-Dade Department of Solid Waste Management (public)
facilities.effectiveText: effective October 1, year not printed; the county's sheet of October 1, 2025 shows $115.80
notes: Non-contract disposal rate $119.51 a ton; the $78.56 contract rate is only for permitted haulers and municipalities.
Waste delivered to a Regional Transfer Station adds $17.86 a ton (non-contract).
Waste tires $140 a ton. No cash accepted.

facilities.name: Los Reales Sustainability Campus

smallLoad.label: resident bringing their own load, loads of 2,000 lbs or less

notes: Residential self-haul: $18 a load up to 2,000 lbs; heavier loads pay the $38 a ton commercial rate.
Environmental fee $2 a load.
Passenger tires from residents who bring their own load $5 each; refrigerant appliances $20 each.

facilities.name: Larimer County Landfill
facilities.effectiveText: 2026 fee schedule (2027 rates proposed, pending approval)
facilities.flatNote: flat fee including the Colorado surcharge; loose loads in trailers are charged by the cubic yard
notes: Car, SUV or passenger van $20; pickup or cargo van $37.
Mattresses and box springs $40 each (recycled).
Auto and light truck tires up to 16.5 in. $7.50, $13.50 with rim.
Appliances with Freon $36 each.

facilities.name: Broome County Landfill
facilities.operator: Broome County Division of Solid Waste Management (public)
notes: Broome County residents only, with proof of residency.
Automatic $20 charge for uncovered loads.
Tires up to 20 in. rim $4 each, up to 15.

facilities.name: Trail Ridge Landfill

smallLoad.label: first 500 lbs (residential rate listed by the city)

notes: Regular waste (household garbage, building materials) $30.30 a ton; yard waste $25 a ton.
The city lists a $1 charge for the first 500 lbs and $30.30 a ton above.
Passenger car tires $1.50 each at the weigh station at the gate; appliances $20 each.

facilities.name: Washington County landfill
facilities.effectiveText: 2026 rate column of the approved master fee schedule

residentFree.label: Washington County residents: one load under a ton a month, free

notes: Municipal solid waste $37.15 a ton.
Residential: less than one ton per month at no charge.
Uncovered loads pay double the trash rate.
facilities.residentHelp: Yes for Washington County residents: one load a month, under a ton, is free. No for everyone else.

facilities.name: Greater El Paso Landfill
facilities.operator: City of El Paso Environmental Services (public)

smallLoad.label: per truckload under one ton ("fees begin at")

notes: The city says disposal fees begin at $16 per truckload for waste under one ton; it publishes no per-ton rate on that page.
Formerly the Clint Landfill.

facilities.name: Alcoa/Maryville/Blount County Sanitary Landfill
notes: Blount County residents and businesses only, proof required.
$15 minimum for 500 lbs or less, then $60 a ton.
Mattresses and box springs $25 each; refrigerated appliances $20.

facilities.name: Recycle & Reuse Drop-off Center
notes: Free for Austin and Travis County residents, by appointment, except tires at $6 each.
Takes recycling, reuse items and household hazardous waste, not trash, furniture or mattresses.
